taxonomic_note: Legacy Master Plant Pool name Lesquerella densiflora normalized to current accepted Physaria densiflora.
look_here_first: Low annual bladderpod with dense yellow flower clusters, stellate-scaly hairs, and round to obovoid inflated capsules on spreading pedicels.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local legacy source; Kew accepts Physaria densiflora; Williamson County flora documents Central Texas morphology.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; broader exact-county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.
best_field_traits: yellow to orange dense terminal racemes
fruiting pedicels spreading to nearly horizontal
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Low, compact, densely flowered annual. Compared with P. gracilis, it is shorter and denser; compared with P. engelmannii, it is annual rather than perennial.
